description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kolinjadiya, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
